Interface SecretKeyResolver

public interface SecretKeyResolver
Resolves encryption keys by their integer key ID (kid). Implementations back this interface with a KMS, Vault, keystore, or a simple in-memory map.

The resolver is called on both the encode path (via currentKid()) and the decode path (for any kid embedded in existing ciphertext). Implementations MUST be able to resolve every kid that appears in stored data — retiring a kid makes all blobs encrypted under that kid permanently unreadable.
